subject: 17 Green Road Demolition Delay
overview: The Medford Historical Commission voted to release the demolition delay for 17 Green Road following architectural revisions. Commissioners also discussed methods to streamline the demolition delay review process.

items.title: 17 Green Road Demolition Delay
items.summary: The Commission voted to release the demolition delay for 17 Green Road based on revised plans for the proposed addition.

items.title: Demolition Delay Process Review
items.summary: Commissioners discussed strategies to accelerate demolition delay review timelines and agreed to survey other Massachusetts historical commissions on their procedures.
